                                <textarea id="contact-message-input" rows="4" required maxlength="1500" class="w-full bg-emerald-950/80 border border-emerald-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-mesota-accent" placeholder="Cum ne poți ajuta sau ce întrebări ai..."></textarea>
                            </div>
                            <!-- Câmp-capcană anti-spam (invizibil pentru vizitatori) -->
                            <div aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:auto;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;">
                                <label>Nu completa acest câmp <input type="text" id="contact-website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label>
                            </div>

                            <button type="submit" id="contact-submit-btn" class="btn-emerald w-full py-3 rounded-lg font-bold text-base flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                                <i id="contact-submit-icon" class="fa-solid fa-paper-plane"></i>
                                <span id="contact-submit-label">Trimite mesajul</span>
                            </button>

                            <!-- Răspuns vizibil după apăsarea butonului -->
                            <div id="contact-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" class="hidden"></div>

                            <!-- Variante de rezervă dacă trimiterea automată eșuează -->
                            <div id="contact-fallback" class="hidden rounded-lg border border-emerald-800 bg-emerald-950/60 p-4 space-y-3">
                                <p class="text-xs text-gray-300">Mesajul tău a rămas în formular. Îl poți trimite și așa:</p>
                                <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                                    <a id="contact-fallback-gmail" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn-emerald flex-1 text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">
                                        <i class="fa-brands fa-google"></i> Deschide în Gmail
                                    </a>
                                    <a id="contact-fallback-mailto" href="#" class="flex-1 text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white transition">
                                        <i class="fa-solid fa-envelope"></i> Aplicația de email
                                    </a>
                                    <button type="button" onclick="copyContactMessage()" class="flex-1 text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white transition">
                                        <i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i> Copiază mesajul
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <p class="text-gray-400 text-xs">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-lock text-mesota-accent"></i>
                                Mesajul ajunge direct la echipă și este livrat prin serviciul FormSubmit.
                            </p>
                        </form>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
    </main>

            </div>
            <p class="text-gray-300 text-xs flex justify-center items-center gap-4">
                <span><i class="fa-solid fa-phone text-mesota-accent"></i> <span id="footer-phone">+40 700 000 000</span></span>
                <span><i class="fa-solid fa-envelope text-mesota-accent"></i> <span id="footer-email">robotica@mesota.ro</span></span>
            </p>
            <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm">
                &copy; <span id="year">2026</span> Colegiul Național „Dr. Ioan Meșotă” Brașov. Toate drepturile rezervate.

            <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
        </button>
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); stepLightbox(-1)" class="absolute left-2 sm:left-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white text-xl" aria-label="Anterioara">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i>
        </button>
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); stepLightbox(1)" class="absolute right-2 sm:right-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white text-xl" aria-label="Următoarea">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i>
        </button>
        <figure class="max-w-5xl w-full text-center" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
            <img id="lightbox-img" src="" alt="" class="max-h-[80vh] mx-auto rounded-xl shadow-2xl object-contain">
            <figcaption id="lightbox-caption" class="mt-4 text-gray-200 text-sm"></figcaption>
        </figure>
    </div>

            <button onclick="toggleAdminModal()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-xl">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>

            <div class="text-center mb-6">

                </div>
                <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Autentificare Admin</h3>

            </div>

                <div>

                </div>

            </div>
        </div>

                    </div>

                    </div>

                <div class="mt-4 flex justify-end">

                    Dezactivează secțiunea când schimbi contul sau cardul pe care intră banii, apoi pune noul link și reactiv-o.

        <div class="glass-panel max-w-lg w-full p-6 rounded-2xl relative shadow-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">

                <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
            </button>
            <h3 id="gallery-modal-title" class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4">Adaugă / Editează Poză</h3>
            <form onsubmit="saveGalleryForm(event)" class="space-y-4">
                <input type="hidden" id="gallery-id">

                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 mb-1">URL Imagine</label>

                </div>

                    <input type="file" id="gallery-file" accept="image/*" onchange="handleGalleryFile(event)" class="w-full text-xs text-gray-300 file:mr-3 file:py-2 file:px-3 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-mesota-emerald file:text-white file:font-semibold hover:file:bg-mesota-hover">
                </div>

                </div>

                    <img id="gallery-preview" src="" alt="" class="w-full h-48 object-cover rounded-lg border border-emerald-800">
                </div>
                <div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
                    <button type="button" onclick="closeGalleryModal()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-white">Anulează</button>
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-emerald px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">Salvează Poza</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 mb-1">Nume & Prenume</label>
                    <input type="text" id="member-name" required class="w-full bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none">

    <!-- PROJECT EDIT/ADD MODAL -->
    <div id="project-edit-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 hidden flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div class="glass-panel max-w-lg w-full p-6 rounded-2xl relative shadow-2xl">
            <button onclick="closeProjectModal()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-xl">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
            </button>
            <h3 id="project-modal-title" class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4">Adaugă / Editează Proiect</h3>
            <form onsubmit="saveProjectForm(event)" class="space-y-4">
                <input type="hidden" id="project-id">
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 mb-1">Titlu Proiect</label>
                    <input type="text" id="project-title" required class="w-full bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none">
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 mb-1">URL Imagine Proiect</label>
                    <input type="text" id="project-image" required class="w-full bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none" placeholder="https://...">
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 mb-1">Descriere Detaliată</label>
                    <textarea id="project-desc" rows="4" required class="w-full bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
                    <button type="button" onclick="closeProjectModal()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-white">Anulează</button>
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-emerald px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">Salvează Proiect</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- JAVASCRIPT APPLICATION LOGIC -->
    <script>
        const MAX_GALLERY = 20;

        // Initial Mock Data
        const defaultData = {
            settings: {
                title: "Robotică Meșotă",
                heroTitle: "Inovație și Performanță în Robotică",
                heroSubtitle: "Echipa de robotică a Colegiului Național „Dr. Ioan Meșotă” Brașov proiectează, programează și construiește viitorul tehnologiei pas cu pas.",
                heroBg: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1485827404703-89b55fcc595e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80",
                phone: "+40 700 000 000",
                email: "robotica.mesota@gmail.com",
                instagram: "https://www.instagram.com/",
                facebook: "https://www.facebook.com/",
                tiktok: "https://www.tiktok.com/",
                donateEnabled: false,
                donateLink: "",
                donateTitle: "Susține echipa",
                donateText: "Fiecare contribuție ne ajută să achiziționăm componente, să construim roboți mai buni și să ajungem la competiții. Mulțumim că ești alături de noi!",
                adminPassword: "mesota2026"
            },
            gallery: [
                { id: "g1", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1485827404703-89b55fcc595e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80", caption: "Pregătiri pentru competiție" },
                { id: "g2", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1561557944-6e7860d1a7eb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80", caption: "Robotul FTC în atelier" },
                { id: "g3", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1581092160607-ee22621dd758?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80", caption: "Testare braț robotic" },
                { id: "g4", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518770660439-4636190af475?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80", caption: "Dezvoltare software autonom" }
            ],
            members: [
                {
                    id: "m1",
                    name: "Alexandru Popa",
                    role: "Team Leader & CAD Designer",
                    photo: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80",
                    desc: "Pasionat de proiectare 3D în Fusion 360 și mecatronică de precizie."
                },
                {
                    id: "m2",
                    name: "Elena Ionescu",
                    role: "Lead Software Developer",
                    photo: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517841905240-472988babdf9?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80",
                    desc: "Specializată în autonome Java, sisteme de viziune computerizată OpenCV."
                },
                {
                    id: "m3",
                    name: "Matei Radu",
                    role: "Hardware & Driver",
                    photo: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80",
                    desc: "Responsabil de asamblarea mecanică și pilotarea robotului în meciuri."
                },
                {
                    id: "m4",
                    name: "Daria Stanciu",
                    role: "PR & Notebook Manager",
                    photo: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?auto=format&fit=crop&w=500&q=80",
                    desc: "Gestionează documentația tehnică, portofoliul echipei și social media."
                }
            ],
            projects: [
                {
                    id: "p1",
                    title: "Robot FTC Season 2025-2026",
                    image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1561557944-6e7860d1a7eb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
                    desc: "Robot competitiv echipat cu sasiu Mecanum, arm colectare din fibra de carbon si autonomie bazata pe senzori odometrici."
                },
                {
                    id: "p2",
                    title: "Braț Robotic Articulat 6-DOF",
                    image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1581092160607-ee22621dd758?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
                    desc: "Proiect educațional imprimat 3D, controlat prin servomotoare digitale și aplicație mobilă dedicată."
                },
                {
                    id: "p3",
                    title: "Sistem de Navigație Autonomă",
                    image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518770660439-4636190af475?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80",
                    desc: "Modul software bazat pe camera Intel RealSense pentru mapare spațială și evitare automată a obstacolelor."
                }
            ]
        };

        // State Management
        let appData;
        try {
            appData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mesota_robotics_data')) || defaultData;
        } catch (err) {
            appData = defaultData;
        }
        // Migrare: datele salvate înainte de adăugarea galeriei
        if (!Array.isArray(appData.gallery)) {
            appData.gallery = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaultData.gallery));
        }

        // Migrare: linkuri social pentru date salvate anterior
        ['instagram', 'facebook', 'tiktok'].forEach(k => {
            if (appData.settings[k] === undefined) appData.settings[k] = defaultData.settings[k];
        });

        // Migrare: setări donații pentru date salvate anterior
        ['donateEnabled', 'donateLink', 'donateTitle', 'donateText'].forEach(k => {
            if (appData.settings[k] === undefined) appData.settings[k] = defaultData.settings[k];
        });

        // Initialize UI on Load
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            renderPublicContent();
        });

        // Save State to LocalStorage
        function saveState() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('mesota_robotics_data', JSON.stringify(appData));
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Nu s-au putut salva datele: spațiul de stocare al browserului este plin. Folosește URL-uri în loc de poze încărcate sau șterge câteva poze.');
                return false;
            }
            renderPublicContent();
            if(!document.getElementById('admin-dashboard-modal').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderAdminDashboard();
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Escape pentru text introdus de utilizator în atribute/HTML
        function esc(str) {
            return String(str == null ? '' : str)
                .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
                .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
        }

        // Render Public Facing Content
        function renderPublicContent() {
            // Settings & Hero
            document.getElementById('site-title-nav').innerText = appData.settings.title;
            document.getElementById('site-title-footer').innerText = appData.settings.title;
            document.getElementById('hero-title').innerText = appData.settings.heroTitle;
            document.getElementById('hero-subtitle').innerText = appData.settings.heroSubtitle;
            document.getElementById('hero-bg-div').style.backgroundImage = `url('${appData.settings.heroBg}')`;

            // Phone & Email
            const phone = appData.settings.phone || "+40 700 000 000";
            const email = appData.settings.email || "robotica.mesota@gmail.com";
            document.getElementById('contact-phone-display').innerText = phone;
            document.getElementById('contact-email-display').innerText = email;
            document.getElementById('footer-phone').innerText = phone;
            document.getElementById('footer-email').innerText = email;

            // Social buttons (butonul se ascunde dacă linkul e gol)
            const fixUrl = (u) => {
                u = (u || '').trim();
                if (!u) return '';
                return /^https?:\/\//i.test(u) ? u : 'https://' + u;
            };
            const setSocial = (id, href) => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (href) {
                    el.href = href;
                    el.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    el.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            };
            setSocial('social-instagram', fixUrl(appData.settings.instagram));
            setSocial('social-facebook', fixUrl(appData.settings.facebook));
            setSocial('social-tiktok', fixUrl(appData.settings.tiktok));
            setSocial('social-gmail', (appData.settings.email || '').trim()
                ? 'https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=' + encodeURIComponent(appData.settings.email.trim())
                : '');
            const anySocial = ['social-instagram', 'social-facebook', 'social-tiktok', 'social-gmail']
                .some(id => !document.getElementById(id).classList.contains('hidden'));
            document.getElementById('social').classList.toggle('hidden', !anySocial);

            // Donate section (vizibilă doar dacă e activată și are link)
            const donateLink = fixUrl(appData.settings.donateLink);
            const donateOn = !!appData.settings.donateEnabled && !!donateLink;
            document.getElementById('doneaza').classList.toggle('hidden', !donateOn);
            document.getElementById('nav-donate').classList.toggle('hidden', !donateOn);
            document.getElementById('nav-donate-m').classList.toggle('hidden', !donateOn);
            document.getElementById('donate-title').innerText = appData.settings.donateTitle || 'Susține echipa';
            document.getElementById('donate-text').innerText = appData.settings.donateText || '';
            document.getElementById('donate-btn').href = donateLink || '#';

            // Gallery Grid (ascunde secțiunea dacă nu există poze)
            const gallerySection = document.getElementById('galerie');
            const galleryGrid = document.getElementById('gallery-grid');
            if (appData.gallery.length === 0) {
                gallerySection.classList.add('hidden');
            } else {
                gallerySection.classList.remove('hidden');
                galleryGrid.innerHTML = appData.gallery.map((g, i) => `
                    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(${i})">
                        <img src="${esc(g.image)}" alt="${esc(g.caption || 'Poză galerie')}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/600x450/043919/ffffff?text=Poză'">
                        ${g.caption ? `<div class="gallery-caption">${esc(g.caption)}</div>` : ''}
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            // Members Grid
            const membersGrid = document.getElementById('members-grid');
            membersGrid.innerHTML = appData.members.map(m => `
                <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden group">
                    <div class="h-64 overflow-hidden relative">
                        <img src="${m.photo}" alt="${m.name}" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition duration-500" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/400x400/043919/ffffff?text=Membru'">
                        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-mesota-dark via-transparent to-transparent"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="p-6">
                        <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-mesota-accent uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">${m.role}</span>
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">${m.name}</h3>
                        <p class="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed">${m.desc || ''}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            // Projects Grid
            const projectsGrid = document.getElementById('projects-grid');
            projectsGrid.innerHTML = appData.projects.map(p => `
                <div class="glass-card rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <div class="h-48 overflow-hidden">
                            <img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.title}" class="w-full h-full object-cover hover:scale-105 transition duration-500" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/600x400/043919/ffffff?text=Proiect'">
                        </div>
                        <div class="p-6">
                            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-3">${p.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-300 text-sm leading-relaxed">${p.desc}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        // Lightbox
        let lightboxIndex = 0;

        function openLightbox(index) {
            lightboxIndex = index;
            showLightboxImage();
            document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function showLightboxImage() {
            const g = appData.gallery[lightboxIndex];
            if (!g) return;
            const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
            img.src = g.image;
            img.alt = g.caption || 'Poză galerie';
            document.getElementById('lightbox-caption').innerText = g.caption || '';
        }

        function stepLightbox(dir) {
            const n = appData.gallery.length;
            if (!n) return;
            lightboxIndex = (lightboxIndex + dir + n) % n;
            showLightboxImage();
        }

        function closeLightbox() {
            document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.contains('hidden')) return;
            if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox();
            if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') stepLightbox(-1);
            if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') stepLightbox(1);
        });

        // Admin Authentication & Modal Toggle
        function toggleAdminModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('admin-login-modal');
            modal.classList.toggle('hidden');
            document.getElementById('login-error').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function handleAdminLogin(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const pass = document.getElementById('admin-pass-input').value;
            const currentPass = appData.settings.adminPassword || 'mesota2026';
            if(pass === currentPass) {
                toggleAdminModal();
                document.getElementById('admin-pass-input').value = '';
                openAdminDashboard();
            } else {
                document.getElementById('login-error').classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }

        function openAdminDashboard() {
            document.getElementById('admin-dashboard-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            renderAdminDashboard();
        }

        function logoutAdmin() {
            document.getElementById('admin-dashboard-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        // Render Admin Dashboard
        function renderAdminDashboard() {
            // Fill General Inputs
            document.getElementById('edit-site-title').value = appData.settings.title;
            document.getElementById('edit-hero-title').value = appData.settings.heroTitle;
            document.getElementById('edit-hero-subtitle').value = appData.settings.heroSubtitle;
            document.getElementById('edit-hero-bg').value = appData.settings.heroBg;
            document.getElementById('edit-contact-phone').value = appData.settings.phone || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-contact-email').value = appData.settings.email || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-admin-pass').value = appData.settings.adminPassword || 'mesota2026';
            document.getElementById('edit-instagram').value = appData.settings.instagram || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-facebook').value = appData.settings.facebook || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-tiktok').value = appData.settings.tiktok || '';

            // Donation fields
            document.getElementById('edit-donate-enabled').checked = !!appData.settings.donateEnabled;
            document.getElementById('edit-donate-link').value = appData.settings.donateLink || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-donate-title').value = appData.settings.donateTitle || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-donate-text').value = appData.settings.donateText || '';
            const badge = document.getElementById('donate-status-badge');
            if (appData.settings.donateEnabled) {
                badge.innerText = 'Activă';
                badge.className = 'text-xs font-semibold rounded-full px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-900/60 text-mesota-accent border border-emerald-600';
            } else {
                badge.innerText = 'Dezactivată';
                badge.className = 'text-xs font-semibold rounded-full px-3 py-1 bg-red-900/60 text-red-200 border border-red-700';
            }

            // Render Admin Gallery List
            const count = appData.gallery.length;
            document.getElementById('gallery-counter').innerText = `${count} / ${MAX_GALLERY}`;
            document.getElementById('add-gallery-btn').disabled = count >= MAX_GALLERY;
            const adminGallery = document.getElementById('admin-gallery-list');
            if (count === 0) {
                adminGallery.innerHTML = `<p class="text-sm text-gray-400 text-center py-4">Nu există poze în galerie. Adaugă prima poză.</p>`;
            } else {
                adminGallery.innerHTML = appData.gallery.map((g, i) => `
                    <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between p-4 bg-emerald-950/60 rounded-xl border border-emerald-900 gap-4">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-4 w-full sm:w-auto min-w-0">
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 w-5 text-center">${i + 1}</span>
                            <img src="${esc(g.image)}" class="w-20 h-14 rounded-lg object-cover border border-emerald-500 shrink-0" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/100x70/043919/ffffff?text=Poză'">
                            <div class="min-w-0">
                                <h4 class="font-bold text-white text-sm truncate">${esc(g.caption) || '<span class="text-gray-500 font-normal">(fără descriere)</span>'}</h4>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
                            <button onclick="moveGallery('${g.id}', -1)" ${i === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-900 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-xs rounded text-white disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed" title="Mută mai sus"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up"></i></button>
                            <button onclick="moveGallery('${g.id}', 1)" ${i === count - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} class="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-900 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-xs rounded text-white disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed" title="Mută mai jos"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down"></i></button>
                            <button onclick="editGallery('${g.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded text-white">Editează</button>
                            <button onclick="deleteGallery('${g.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-red-900 hover:bg-red-800 text-xs font-semibold rounded text-white">Șterge</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }

            // Render Admin Members List
            const adminMembers = document.getElementById('admin-members-list');
            adminMembers.innerHTML = appData.members.map(m => `
                <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between p-4 bg-emerald-950/60 rounded-xl border border-emerald-900 gap-4">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4 w-full sm:w-auto">
                        <img src="${m.photo}" class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-emerald-500" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/100x100/043919/ffffff?text=User'">
                        <div>
                            <h4 class="font-bold text-white">${m.name}</h4>
                            <span class="text-xs text-mesota-accent">${m.role}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
                        <button onclick="editMember('${m.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded text-white">Editează</button>
                        <button onclick="deleteMember('${m.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-red-900 hover:bg-red-800 text-xs font-semibold rounded text-white">Șterge</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            // Render Admin Projects List
            const adminProjects = document.getElementById('admin-projects-list');
            adminProjects.innerHTML = appData.projects.map(p => `
                <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between p-4 bg-emerald-950/60 rounded-xl border border-emerald-900 gap-4">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4 w-full sm:w-auto">
                        <img src="${p.image}" class="w-16 h-12 rounded-lg object-cover border border-emerald-500" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/100x100/043919/ffffff?text=Project'">
                        <div>
                            <h4 class="font-bold text-white">${p.title}</h4>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
                        <button onclick="editProject('${p.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded text-white">Editează</button>
                        <button onclick="deleteProject('${p.id}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-red-900 hover:bg-red-800 text-xs font-semibold rounded text-white">Șterge</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        // Save General Settings
        function saveGeneralSettings() {
            const emailToSave = document.getElementById('edit-contact-email').value.trim();
            if (emailToSave && !isValidEmail(emailToSave)) {
                alert('Adresa de email nu este validă. Verific-o (ex: echipa@gmail.com) și încearcă din nou.');
                return;
            }
            appData.settings.title = document.getElementById('edit-site-title').value;
            appData.settings.heroTitle = document.getElementById('edit-hero-title').value;
            appData.settings.heroSubtitle = document.getElementById('edit-hero-subtitle').value;
            appData.settings.heroBg = document.getElementById('edit-hero-bg').value;
            appData.settings.phone = document.getElementById('edit-contact-phone').value;
            appData.settings.email = emailToSave;
            appData.settings.instagram = document.getElementById('edit-instagram').value.trim();
            appData.settings.facebook = document.getElementById('edit-facebook').value.trim();
            appData.settings.tiktok = document.getElementById('edit-tiktok').value.trim();
            
            const newPass = document.getElementById('edit-admin-pass').value.trim();
            if(newPass) {
                appData.settings.adminPassword = newPass;
            }

            if (saveState()) {
                alert('Setările generale, datele de contact și parola au fost salvate cu succes!');
            }
        }

        // Donation Management Operations
        function normalizeUrl(u) {
            u = (u || '').trim();
            if (!u) return '';
            return /^https?:\/\//i.test(u) ? u : 'https://' + u;
        }

        // Pornit/oprit imediat din comutator
        function toggleDonation(on) {
            const link = normalizeUrl(document.getElementById('edit-donate-link').value || appData.settings.donateLink);
            if (on && !link) {
                alert('Introdu mai întâi linkul de plată și salvează, apoi activează secțiunea.');
                document.getElementById('edit-donate-enabled').checked = false;
                return;
            }
            const previous = appData.settings.donateEnabled;
            appData.settings.donateEnabled = on;
            if (on) appData.settings.donateLink = link;
            if (!saveState()) {
                appData.settings.donateEnabled = previous;
                renderAdminDashboard();
            }
        }

        function saveDonationSettings() {
            const link = normalizeUrl(document.getElementById('edit-donate-link').value);
            appData.settings.donateLink = link;
            appData.settings.donateTitle = document.getElementById('edit-donate-title').value.trim();
            appData.settings.donateText = document.getElementById('edit-donate-text').value.trim();
            if (!link) appData.settings.donateEnabled = false;
            if (saveState()) {
                alert(link
                    ? 'Setările de donații au fost salvate.'
                    : 'Setările au fost salvate. Fără link de plată, secțiunea rămâne dezactivată.');
            }
        }

        // Gallery Management Operations
        function openGalleryModal(galleryId = null) {
            if (!galleryId && appData.gallery.length >= MAX_GALLERY) {
                alert(`Ai atins limita de ${MAX_GALLERY} poze. Șterge o poză pentru a adăuga alta.`);
                return;
            }
            document.getElementById('gallery-edit-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('gallery-file').value = '';
            if (galleryId) {
                const g = appData.gallery.find(item => item.id === galleryId);
                document.getElementById('gallery-modal-title').innerText = "Editează Poză";
                document.getElementById('gallery-id').value = g.id;
                document.getElementById('gallery-image').value = g.image;
                document.getElementById('gallery-caption').value = g.caption || '';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('gallery-modal-title').innerText = "Adaugă Poză Nouă";
                document.getElementById('gallery-id').value = '';
                document.getElementById('gallery-image').value = '';
                document.getElementById('gallery-caption').value = '';
            }
            updateGalleryPreview();
        }

        function closeGalleryModal() {
            document.getElementById('gallery-edit-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function updateGalleryPreview() {
            const url = document.getElementById('gallery-image').value.trim();
            const wrap = document.getElementById('gallery-preview-wrap');
            if (url) {
                document.getElementById('gallery-preview').src = url;
                wrap.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                wrap.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        // Încărcare fișier + redimensionare (max 1000px, JPEG) pentru a economisi spațiu
        function handleGalleryFile(e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = (ev) => {
                const img = new Image();
                img.onload = () => {
                    const maxSide = 1000;
                    const scale = Math.min(1, maxSide / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
                    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                    canvas.width = Math.round(img.width * scale);
                    canvas.height = Math.round(img.height * scale);
                    canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    document.getElementById('gallery-image').value = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.75);
                    updateGalleryPreview();
                };
                img.onerror = () => alert('Fișierul selectat nu este o imagine validă.');
                img.src = ev.target.result;
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }

        function saveGalleryForm(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const id = document.getElementById('gallery-id').value;
            const image = document.getElementById('gallery-image').value.trim();
            if (!image) {
                alert('Introdu un URL sau încarcă o imagine.');
                return;
            }
            const item = {
                id: id ? id : 'g_' + Date.now(),
                image: image,
                caption: document.getElementById('gallery-caption').value.trim()
            };

            const backup = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(appData.gallery));
            if (id) {
                const idx = appData.gallery.findIndex(g => g.id === id);
                appData.gallery[idx] = item;
            } else {
                if (appData.gallery.length >= MAX_GALLERY) {
                    alert(`Ai atins limita de ${MAX_GALLERY} poze.`);
                    return;
                }
                appData.gallery.push(item);
            }

            if (saveState()) {
                closeGalleryModal();
            } else {
                appData.gallery = backup;
            }
        }

        function editGallery(id) {
            openGalleryModal(id);
        }

        function deleteGallery(id) {
            if (confirm('Sigur doriți să ștergeți această poză?')) {
                appData.gallery = appData.gallery.filter(g => g.id !== id);
                saveState();
            }
        }

        function moveGallery(id, dir) {
            const idx = appData.gallery.findIndex(g => g.id === id);
            const newIdx = idx + dir;
            if (idx < 0 || newIdx < 0 || newIdx >= appData.gallery.length) return;
            const tmp = appData.gallery[idx];
            appData.gallery[idx] = appData.gallery[newIdx];
            appData.gallery[newIdx] = tmp;
            saveState();
        }

        // Member Management Operations
        function openMemberModal(memberId = null) {
            document.getElementById('member-edit-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            if(memberId) {
                const m = appData.members.find(item => item.id === memberId);
                document.getElementById('member-modal-title').innerText = "Editează Membru";
                document.getElementById('member-id').value = m.id;
                document.getElementById('member-name').value = m.name;
                document.getElementById('member-role').value = m.role;
                document.getElementById('member-photo').value = m.photo;
                document.getElementById('member-desc').value = m.desc || '';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('member-modal-title').innerText = "Adaugă Membru Nou";
                document.getElementById('member-id').value = '';
                document.getElementById('member-name').value = '';
                document.getElementById('member-role').value = '';
                document.getElementById('member-photo').value = '';
                document.getElementById('member-desc').value = '';
            }
        }

        function closeMemberModal() {
            document.getElementById('member-edit-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function saveMemberForm(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const id = document.getElementById('member-id').value;
            const newMember = {
                id: id ? id : 'm_' + Date.now(),
                name: document.getElementById('member-name').value,
                role: document.getElementById('member-role').value,
                photo: document.getElementById('member-photo').value,
                desc: document.getElementById('member-desc').value
            };

            if(id) {
                const idx = appData.members.findIndex(m => m.id === id);
                appData.members[idx] = newMember;
            } else {
                appData.members.push(newMember);
            }

            saveState();
            closeMemberModal();
        }

        function editMember(id) {
            openMemberModal(id);
        }

        function deleteMember(id) {
            if(confirm('Sigur doriți să ștergeți acest membru?')) {
                appData.members = appData.members.filter(m => m.id !== id);
                saveState();
            }
        }

        // Project Management Operations
        function openProjectModal(projectId = null) {
            document.getElementById('project-edit-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            if(projectId) {
                const p = appData.projects.find(item => item.id === projectId);
                document.getElementById('project-modal-title').innerText = "Editează Proiect";
                document.getElementById('project-id').value = p.id;
                document.getElementById('project-title').value = p.title;
                document.getElementById('project-image').value = p.image;
                document.getElementById('project-desc').value = p.desc;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('project-modal-title').innerText = "Adaugă Proiect Nou";
                document.getElementById('project-id').value = '';
                document.getElementById('project-title').value = '';
                document.getElementById('project-image').value = '';
                document.getElementById('project-desc').value = '';
            }
        }

        function closeProjectModal() {
            document.getElementById('project-edit-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function saveProjectForm(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const id = document.getElementById('project-id').value;
            const newProject = {
                id: id ? id : 'p_' + Date.now(),
                title: document.getElementById('project-title').value,
                image: document.getElementById('project-image').value,
                desc: document.getElementById('project-desc').value
            };

            if(id) {
                const idx = appData.projects.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
                appData.projects[idx] = newProject;
            } else {
                appData.projects.push(newProject);
            }

            saveState();
            closeProjectModal();
        }

        function editProject(id) {
            openProjectModal(id);
        }

        function deleteProject(id) {
            if(confirm('Sigur doriți să ștergeți acest proiect?')) {
                appData.projects = appData.projects.filter(p => p.id !== id);
                saveState();
            }
        }

        // Export Data JSON Backup
        function exportDataJSON() {
            const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(appData, null, 2));
            const downloadAnchor = document.createElement('a');
            downloadAnchor.setAttribute("href", dataStr);
            downloadAnchor.setAttribute("download", "mesota_robotics_backup.json");
            document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchor);
            downloadAnchor.click();
            downloadAnchor.remove();
        }

        // Mobile Menu Toggle
        function toggleMobileMenu() {
            const menu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
            menu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        // ===== Formular de contact =====
        // Mesajul este trimis direct (fără program de email, fără popup-uri) prin FormSubmit.
        // Adresa de destinație se citește din setările de admin la FIECARE trimitere.
        const CONTACT_ENDPOINT = 'https://formsubmit.co/ajax/';
        const DEFAULT_CONTACT_EMAIL = 'robotica.mesota@gmail.com';
        let contactDraft = null; // ultimul mesaj, folosit de variantele de rezervă

        function isValidEmail(v) {
            return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(v || '').trim());
        }

        function getTargetEmail() {
            const saved = (appData.settings.email || '').trim();
            return isValidEmail(saved) ? saved : DEFAULT_CONTACT_EMAIL;
        }

        function buildContactLinks(d) {
            const subject = `Mesaj nou de la ${d.name} - Site Robotică`;
            const body = `Nume: ${d.name}\nEmail: ${d.email}\n\nMesaj:\n${d.message}`;
            return {
                gmail: `https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=${encodeURIComponent(d.to)}&su=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`,
                mailto: `mailto:${d.to}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`,
                text: body
            };
        }

        function showContactStatus(type, text) {
            const el = document.getElementById('contact-status');
            const styles = {
                ok: 'bg-emerald-900/60 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-100',
                error: 'bg-red-900/50 border-red-600 text-red-100',
                info: 'bg-white/10 border-white/20 text-gray-100'
            };
            el.className = 'rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm ' + (styles[type] || styles.info);
            el.textContent = text;
        }

        function setContactSending(on) {
            document.getElementById('contact-submit-btn').disabled = on;
            document.getElementById('contact-submit-label').textContent = on ? 'Se trimite...' : 'Trimite mesajul';
            document.getElementById('contact-submit-icon').className = on ? 'fa-solid fa-spinner fa-spin' : 'fa-solid fa-paper-plane';
        }

        function showContactFallback(d) {
            const links = buildContactLinks(d);
            document.getElementById('contact-fallback-gmail').href = links.gmail;
            document.getElementById('contact-fallback-mailto').href = links.mailto;
            document.getElementById('contact-fallback').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        // Trimitere prin FormSubmit (folosită și de formular, și de butonul de test din admin)
        async function postToFormSubmit(to, payload) {
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15000);
            try {
                const res = await fetch(CONTACT_ENDPOINT + encodeURIComponent(to), {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ _captcha: 'false', _template: 'table' }, payload)),
                    signal: controller.signal
                });
                let json = {};
                try { json = await res.json(); } catch (err) { /* răspuns fără JSON */ }
                return {
                    success: res.ok && (json.success === true || json.success === 'true'),
                    needsActivation: /activat/i.test(String(json.message || '')),
                    message: json.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status)
                };
            } finally {
                clearTimeout(timer);
            }
        }

        async function handleContactSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const form = e.target;

            // Câmpul-capcană completat = robot; nu trimitem nimic
            if (document.getElementById('contact-website').value) return;

            const data = {
                name: document.getElementById('contact-name-input').value.trim(),
                email: document.getElementById('contact-sender-email').value.trim(),
                message: document.getElementById('contact-message-input').value.trim(),
                to: getTargetEmail()
            };

            if (!data.name || !data.message || !isValidEmail(data.email)) {
                showContactStatus('error', 'Completează numele, un email valid și mesajul.');
                return;
            }

            contactDraft = data;
            document.getElementById('contact-fallback').classList.add('hidden');
            setContactSending(true);
            showContactStatus('info', 'Se trimite mesajul...');

            try {
                const result = await postToFormSubmit(data.to, {
                    name: data.name,
                    email: data.email,
                    message: data.message,
                    _subject: `Mesaj nou de la ${data.name} - Site Robotică`
                });
                if (!result.success || result.needsActivation) {
                    throw new Error(result.needsActivation ? 'Adresa de destinație nu este încă activată.' : result.message);
                }
                form.reset();
                contactDraft = null;
                showContactStatus('ok', 'Mesajul a fost trimis. Îți mulțumim! Te vom contacta în curând.');
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Trimiterea automată a eșuat:', err);
                showContactStatus('error', 'Nu am putut trimite mesajul automat. Mesajul tău nu s-a pierdut: folosește una dintre variantele de mai jos.');
                showContactFallback(data);
            } finally {
                setContactSending(false);
            }
        }

        async function copyContactMessage() {
            if (!contactDraft) return;
            const text = `Către: ${contactDraft.to}\n\n` + buildContactLinks(contactDraft).text;
            let copied = false;
            try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
                copied = true;
            } catch (err) {
                const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
                ta.value = text;
                document.body.appendChild(ta);
                ta.select();
                try { copied = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (err2) { copied = false; }
                ta.remove();
            }
            showContactStatus(copied ? 'ok' : 'error', copied
                ? `Mesajul a fost copiat. Lipește-l într-un email către ${contactDraft.to}.`
                : 'Nu am putut copia automat. Selectează textul din formular și copiază-l manual.');
        }

        // Buton de test din admin: trimite un mesaj la adresa din câmp și (la prima folosire) declanșează activarea
        async function sendTestContactMessage() {
            const to = document.getElementById('edit-contact-email').value.trim();
            if (!isValidEmail(to)) {
                alert('Introdu mai întâi o adresă de email validă în câmpul de mai sus.');
                return;
            }
            try {
                const result = await postToFormSubmit(to, {
                    name: 'Test din panoul de admin',
                    email: to,
                    message: 'Acesta este un mesaj de test trimis din panoul de administrare al site-ului.',
                    _subject: 'Test formular site robotică'
                });
                if (result.needsActivation) {
                    alert(`Am trimis cererea de activare la ${to}.\n\nDeschide emailul primit de la FormSubmit (verifică și Spam) și apasă linkul de activare. Abia după aceea formularul de pe site trimite automat mesajele către această adresă.`);
                } else if (result.success) {
                    alert(`Mesajul de test a fost trimis la ${to}. Verifică inboxul (și Spam).`);
                } else {
                    throw new Error(result.message);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Nu am putut contacta serviciul de trimitere: ' + err.message + '\n\nDacă site-ul este deschis direct din fișier sau într-o previzualizare, pune-l pe un hosting. Până atunci, formularul îți oferă variantele de rezervă (Gmail / aplicația de email / copiere).');
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
